guidance: Focus on three distinct angles: (1) origins and mechanism of spread — where it came from, how it moved across Europe so rapidly, the role of fleas, rats, and trade routes; (2) the lived experience and scale of mortality — what dying of plague looked like, how communities responded, the collapse of normal social order; (3) the long-term social and economic transformation — labor shortages, peasant empowerment, Church credibility crisis, and how the Black Death reshaped medieval Europe. Emphasize what actually happened and what it changed, not just death toll numbers.
